scope: epoch-79 RSLAD continuation and the new RNG-source decomposition plumbing
audit_method: repository source inspection; no production trajectory was launched

draws: source-keyed CIFAR crop and horizontal flip

augmentation.status: source-keyed and independent of sampler order

workers.policy: DataLoader CPU generator supplies worker base seeds; Python/NumPy worker seeds descend from torch.initial_seed

model_side_stochasticity.repository_search: no Dropout or StochasticDepth occurrence in src/ard/models
model_side_stochasticity.student: repository-owned SAAD student contains BatchNorm but no stochastic layer found
model_side_stochasticity.teacher: frozen TeacherAdapter forces eval mode; external constructor is treated as an audited dependency
model_side_stochasticity.status: global stream retained as a residual/other control

global_rng_lifecycle.continuation_reseed_boundary: after exact epoch-79 load_checkpoint and before the first epoch-80 iterator
global_rng_lifecycle.legacy_compatibility: --continuation-seed preserves the historical parent data stream and maps the scalar to the legacy attack/global streams

determinism_controls.residual_boundary: same-source REF1/REF2 is required; no arbitrary residual threshold is imposed

checks: REF and ATTACK have identical data identity hashes
REF and ATTACK have different raw PGD draw hashes
REF and DATA have different data identity hashes
REF and DATA have identical raw PGD draw hashes
canary.last_local_result: passed on CPU with one-batch focused test and two-batch command contract

known_limits: The canary proves stream ownership for the observed public paths; it cannot prove absence of hardware-specific CUDA nondeterminism.
The source audit does not claim that external RobustBench constructor internals are stochastic-free; the frozen teacher is forced to eval mode and REF repeat remains the residual control.
No production accuracy or source ranking is claimed before the 16 trajectories and fixed-seed endpoint evaluations complete.
